title: 第三章 出现绿皮上第四章 出现绿皮下
content_zh:
“给！这是我的任务卷轴。”颜铁龙来到发布任务商人面前将自己的任务卷轴交给对方道。
“没有问题，这是你的任务订金，希望你能好好保护我们商队。”商人看了看颜铁龙的任务卷轴确定没有问题就从自己手中钱袋里拿出二枚银币和任务卷轴交给颜铁龙道。
商队的人又等了一会儿，在一次大声道：“我最后一次提醒，豪叫酒馆e级护送古羽镇，请快到这里集合！”。
“请等一下！我们就是接了嚎叫酒馆e级护送古羽镇的冒险者！”在商人刚喊完就一个成熟女性声音喊道。
“呼～，这是我们的任务卷轴。”二位穿着灰色风衣以及带着头冒来到商人面前拿出二张卷轴递给商人道。
“没想到除了我，居然还有人接这个任务，看来这两个人不知道护送古羽镇行情的新手吧。”颜铁龙看着二个穿着风衣的人将任务卷轴交给商人，内心根本没想过那二人跟他一样，去古羽镇顺便接的任务。
“兰姨，我们还没有完成任务，他们为什么给我们钱啊？”在成熟女性身边的神秘人接到商人给的二枚银币就压着声音对身边的同伴疑惑问道。
而颜铁熊恰好听到那个神秘人直接内心想道：“果然是新手啊！”。
“狮特《狮特艾莉雅：重要女主角》，这是护送任务的惯例，本来收到订金的我们这些冒险者还有一段时间购买装备，不过现在我们来晚了，商队要出发了，肯定不会再给我们这些时间了。”被称之兰姨成熟女性对身边侄女解释道。
“兰姨，难道这些商人，不怕我们拿到钱就逃跑吗？”狮特对兰姨问道。
“呵呵，狮特你难道忘记了，我们刚刚登记的冒险徽章吗？”被称之兰姨的人对侄女问道。
“兰姨难道那个登记我们冒险徽章就能保证我们逃跑吗？”狮特对兰姨问道。
“当然，要是你在酒馆登记了冒险徽章，又接了订金而不去完成任务，那对你信誉是极大的打击，以后你在想接任务可是很难才能接到任务了，因为大家不在信任你，所以当冒险者和雇佣兵一但接到任务他们都会尽力完成。”兰姨对自己侄女解释道。
“原来是这样啊，没想到冒险者这么有意思啊！”狮特恍然大悟并兴奋道。
“克米迪斯大叔！时间到了，我们该起程了。”查看颜铁龙他们任务卷轴的年轻商人对领头的姆鲁兽车大声喊道。
颜铁龙听到年轻商人喊话，内心突然惊讶，并看着向商队领头姆鲁兽车，当他看到姆鲁兽车露出头的中年人就叫道：“真的是克米迪斯大叔！”。
“小南，既然那就出发！”克米迪斯对年轻商人吩咐道。
同时他好像突然注意到颜铁龙就微笑道：“咦！铁龙啊！没想到我们又见面了，难道你也接我发布的任务，那真是太好了。”。
颜铁龙看着，故意做出意外的表情的克米迪斯，就好想走他面前，狠狠的给他一拳，但还是忍住，嘴角抽动地说道：“克米迪斯大叔，你就不用装算了，我可是从头到尾都没有说我接了你的护卫任务，而且刚刚你的同伴也没有告诉你谁接了任务。”。
克米迪斯看到颜铁龙脸部抽动的表情就知道他心中有怒火就有点失望的说道：“铁龙啊，我想给你一个意外惊喜，只是没想到你连一点幽默感动没有，真是让人失望啊！”。

颜铁龙听到克米迪斯的话神情突然一变，变得让人感觉十分友善的样子快速来到克米迪斯姆鲁兽车身边，语气变的可怜以及讨好的说道：“克米迪斯大叔，小子这两年过的一点也不好，现在只能啃黑面包以及清水了，不如你先给我二三十枚银币当你护卫任务的报酬，就算可怜我好不好嘛？”。
克米迪斯被颜铁龙突然转变，搞得有点措手不及，但是他很快反应过来，从慈善的表情变得咆哮道：“去你的臭小子，少在我这里装可怜，任务卷轴里写了多少佣金就是多少佣金，多一个子我也不会给你。”。
颜铁龙擦了擦脸部的唾沫一脸嫌弃，以及懊悔道：“早知道我就不接这个破任务了，十枚银币也不知道能买些什么。”。
克米迪斯听到颜铁龙的话高兴得意笑道：“哈哈，十枚银币的确不能买些什么，不过至少不会让你短时间里饿死！”。
克米迪斯得意笑了一会儿，当他在看到一脸懊恼的颜铁龙就想起当年几乎什么都不懂，还满嘴说自己是救世主落魄的乞丐就感慨道：“你这个臭小子，还跟以前一样啊！上来吧，跟叔说这二年都过的怎么样。”。
“克米迪斯大叔，你也跟以前一样，一点都没变，还是那么小气。”颜铁龙说完上姆鲁兽车。
颜铁龙跟克米迪斯突然互动，让认识克米迪斯的人以及接任务二人一脸疑惑样子，但是当颜铁龙上了姆鲁兽车，就知道要出发啦！分分做最后准备开始上路。
content_en:
"Here! This is my mission scroll." Yan Tielong came to the merchant who issued the mission and handed his mission scroll to him.
"No problem. This is your mission deposit. I hope you can protect our caravan." The businessman looked at Yan Tielong's mission scroll and made sure there was no problem. He took out two silver coins and the mission scroll from his wallet and handed it to Yan Tielong.
The people from the caravan waited for a while, and once again loudly said: "My last reminder, Hao Jing Tavern E-level escort Gu Yuzhen, please gather here quickly!".
"Please wait a moment! We are the adventurers who have accepted the Howling Tavern's E-class escort to Guyu Town!" A mature female voice shouted just after the merchant finished shouting.
"Huh~, this is our mission scroll." Wearing gray trench coats and wearing hair hats, the two men came to the businessman and took out two scrolls and handed them to the businessman.
"I didn't expect that other than me, there would be someone else to take on this mission. It seems that these two people are newbies who don't know the situation of escorting Guyu Town." Yan Tielong watched the two men in windbreakers hand over the mission scroll to the businessman, and never thought that those two people were just like him, going to Guyu Town to pick up the mission.
"Aunt Lan, we haven't completed the mission yet, why did they give us money?" The mysterious man next to the mature woman asked in a low voice to his companions after receiving the two silver coins from the businessman.
And Yan Tiexiong happened to hear the mysterious man and thought directly to his heart: "He is indeed a novice!".
"Lion's "Lion Aaliyah: Important Heroine", this is the custom for escort missions. We adventurers who have received the deposit originally still have some time to buy equipment, but now we are late, the caravan is about to set off, and we will definitely not be given this time." The mature woman known as Aunt Lan explained to her niece.
"Aunt Lan, aren't these businessmen afraid that we will run away after getting the money?" Shite asked Aunt Lan.
"Haha, Lion, have you forgotten the adventure badge we just registered?" The person called Aunt Lan asked her niece.
"Aunt Lan, can registering our adventure badge guarantee our escape?" Shite asked Aunt Lan.
"Of course, if you register an adventure badge at the tavern and accept the deposit without completing the mission, it will be a huge blow to your credibility. In the future, if you want to take the mission, it will be difficult to do so because no one trusts you anymore. Therefore, adventurers and mercenaries will try their best to complete the mission once they receive it." Aunt Lan explained to her niece.
"So that's it. I didn't expect adventurers to be so interesting!" Lion suddenly realized and said excitedly.
"Uncle Kemidis! The time has come, we should set off." The young businessman who was checking Yan Tielong's mission scroll shouted to the leading Mulu beast cart.
Yan Tielong was suddenly surprised when he heard the young businessman shouting. He looked at the Mulu beast car leading the caravan. When he saw the middle-aged man showing the head of the Mulu beast car, he shouted: "It's really Uncle Kemedis!".
"Xiaonan, then let's go!" Kemedis ordered the young businessman.
At the same time, he seemed to suddenly notice Yan Tielong and smiled and said: "Hey! Tielong! I didn't expect that we would meet again. Don't you also accept the task I posted? That would be great.".
Yan Tielong looked at Kemedis, who deliberately made an unexpected expression. He wanted to walk in front of him and punch him hard, but he still held back and said with a twitching mouth: "Uncle Kemedis, you don't have to pretend. I never said that I took over your escort mission, and your companion didn't tell you who took over the mission just now."
When Kemidis saw the twitching expression on Yan Tielong's face, he knew that Yan Tielong had anger in his heart, so he said a little disappointed: "Tielong, I wanted to give you an unexpected surprise, but I didn't expect that you didn't even have a sense of humor. It's really disappointing!".
Yan Tielong heard that Ke MiDis's expression suddenly changed when he said this, and he became very friendly. He quickly came to the side of the Kemedis Mulu beast cart, and his tone became pitiful and flattering and said: "Uncle Kemedis, the kid has not had a good life in the past two years. Now he can only eat black bread and water. Why don't you give me twenty or thirty silver coins as a reward for your escort mission? How about you pity me?"
Kemidis was caught off guard by Yan Tielong's sudden change, but he quickly reacted and changed his expression from charity to roaring: "Fuck you brat, stop pretending to be pitiful for me. The commission is as much as the commission written in the mission scroll, and I won't give you even one more cent."
Yan Tielong wiped the saliva from his face with a look of disgust on his face, and said regretfully: "If I had known better, I wouldn't have accepted this crappy mission. I don't know what I can buy with ten silver coins."
Kemedis smiled happily when he heard Yan Tielong's words: "Haha, ten silver coins can't buy anything, but at least you won't starve to death in a short time!".
Kemedis smiled proudly for a while. When he saw Yan Tielong with an annoyed look on his face, he remembered the beggar who knew almost nothing back then and kept saying that he was the savior. He sighed with emotion: "You brat, you are still the same as before! Come up here and tell me how you have been in the past two years."
"Uncle Kemedis, you are still the same as before, you haven't changed at all, you are still so stingy." After Yan Tielong said that, he got on the Mulu beast cart.
The sudden interaction between Yan Tielong and Kermitis made the people who knew Kermitis and the two people who took the mission look confused. But when Yan Tielong got on the Mulu beast cart, he knew it was time to set off! Make final preparations and start on the road.
